1.consolidated_definition: Agarre, control. Fuerte dominio sobre algo o alguien. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Don Luis, El Vate, prueba su grip o agarre, ya cercano a uno de sus últimos turnos al bate ()
1.en_consolidated_definition: Grasp, control. Strong dominance over something or someone. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. Don Luis, The Poet, tests his grip or grasp, already nearing one of his final turns at bat.
